summary: Comprehensive E2E test of the review request: Volunteer Hours (public log form + admin review + /transparency aggregation), Program Interest Report (CSV + 6-month table + trend arrows + current-month increment on new signup), Impact-email tracking endpoints (pixel GIF, click redirect with //evil.com open-redirect protection, history initial-empty shape), Story-request email toggle (persist across reload + restore ON), Programs Admin signup card, and Share Story dialog auto-open on /initiatives/<slug>?share=1. Backend: 20/20 pytest PASS. Frontend: all specified selectors behave as expected. One leftover concern: Admin page defaults to Media Library on reload instead of persisting last tab (minor UX), handled in retest by re-clicking the Stories tab.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3800 lines - continues to grow with story-request / impact-tracking / hours routers appended. Should be split into story_requests.py, impact.py, volunteer_hours.py, reports.py routers for maintainability.

Impact click endpoint uses a regex to validate paths; it allows backslashes-free relative URLs correctly, but note query params use & which is in the whitelist - verified /programs case works. Would benefit from a unit test matrix (javascript:, http://evil.com, /\\evil.com) - open-redirect is correctly blocked for the //evil.com case tested here.

/admin/reports/program-signups uses an aggregation that re-fetches program titles via `programs.find_one` inside the loop - acceptable for 6 programs but N+1-prone; batch fetch keyed by id would be cleaner.
Rate limit 'hours' = 10/10min/IP: works but may be aggressive if a staff member logs multiple sessions per volunteer; consider admin-session bypass.
/volunteer-hours/summary iterates distinct emails per request - fine today, but should be cached for the public /transparency page which fetches it on every visit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoints verified: POST /api/volunteer-hours (rate 'hours' 10/10min/IP, hours 0.25-24, program must be published, date within past 365 days, no future), GET /api/admin/volunteer-hours (admin), POST /api/admin/volunteer-hours/{id}/{approve|reject} (404 when not pending), GET /api/volunteer-hours/summary (public, returns {total_hours, volunteers, by_program:[{program,hours}]}). GET /api/admin/reports/program-signups?months=N returns {months:[YYYY-MM...], rows:[{program,counts:[],total,trend:'up'|'down'|'flat'}], totals:[]}. GET /api/t/impact/{cid}/open.gif returns 1x1 image/gif with Cache-Control:no-store (no DB mutation unless the cid/rid pair exists). GET /api/t/impact/{cid}/click?r=&u= returns 302 to PUBLIC_APP_URL+safe-path; `u` is validated with ^/[A-Za-z0-9/_\-?=&.]*$ AND !startswith('//') otherwise falls back to '/'. GET /api/admin/impact-email/history returns {items:[{id,sent_at,sent,opens,clicks,open_rate,click_rate,...}]}. _send_story_requests cron (server.py:3326) scans submissions type=program_signup created_at<=now-60d, sets story_request_sent=True and emails /initiatives/{slug}?share=1. Settings key story_requests_enabled toggles via PUT /api/admin/settings. All CSRF-protected mutations require X-Requested-With:XMLHttpRequest when session_token cookie is present. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_sisters_reports_hours_impact.py (20 tests, 2.5s) uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + MONGO_URL + DB_NAME env vars - run with `cd /app && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database python3 -m pytest backend/tests/test_sisters_reports_hours_impact.py -v`.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The two initial test failures (`test_report_shape` and `test_signup_increments_current_month`) were test-side mismatches - server returns {rows,months,totals} but tests expected {items,months}. Fixed in test file; both re-pass.
